release_when: After independent GitHub readback of taxonomy-only evidence or lease expiry
notes: Verify accepted C. dactylon, historic infraspecific synonyms mapping to C. radiatus, separate C. transvaalensis and accepted hybrid C. × magennisii. Preserve turf specimen and hybrid holds; no canonical or photo changes.
release_note: 19 taxonomy-only decisions independently read back: 14 PASS, 2 FAIL, 2 HOLD, 1 UNRESOLVED. Historical C. dactylon var. intermedius and subsp. arcuatus belong under accepted C. radiatus; C. × magennisii is an accepted hybrid of C. dactylon × C. transvaalensis. Specimen/cultivar holds preserved; no canonical species, photo, range, or Pages edits.
